column3: Settled handy in the early stages - pushed to the front two furlongs out - drifted right causing interference - stayed on inside the last furlong to assert late
Bumped at the break - settled towards the back - pressed for effort 3f out - moved up to challenge over 1f out but unable to reel in winner
Bumped and drifted left at the off - settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along over 2f out - moved across right approaching final furlong - stayed on to take third close home
Pulled hard early - settled in the middle of the field - pushed along and made progress 2f out - plugged on at one speed inside the final furlong - dropped to 4th close home
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked front group - pushed along 2f out and knocked sideways soon after - continued at an unchanged effort inside final furlong to finish 5th
Hampered start and drifted left - quickly settled to share front running - pushed along and lost command 2f out - squeezed for room soon after and unable to fight back
Drifted left and hampered for room at the break - settled in the pack before pressed for effort 2f out - lost ground into the final furlong to finish 7th
Shared control early - pressed and lost front spot 2f out then bumped soon after - unable to bounce back finished well beaten
Set the pace from the break - driven and lost the advantage close to the final furlong - regained the front inside it - dug deep to prevail on the line
Raced handy - closed on the pace inside final furlong to loom dangerous - flattened out close home to lose out by a short head

Drifted left at the break and was tardy away - recovered quickly to sit wide in second - took over marginally past the 1f pole before being overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on to dispute the finish but found nil in the closing strides and was third
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - made progress to close on the front group inside the last - kept on but couldn't quite sustain the effort
Held up at the back - shifted through the middle from 3f out - progress inside the final furlong - kept on without the speed to get on terms close home - fifth
Held a forward spot early - asked for effort two out and driven inside final furlong - lost ground close home to finish sixth
Held up early - improved into contention approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish seventh
Held up at the back - driven approaching final 2f and boxed for space inside the closing stages - stayed on to finish eighth beaten 3 lengths
Held up early - shifted wide to close ground 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong and dropped away late
Held handy early - pressed into the pack approaching 2f out then pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away close home to finish 10th
Held mid-pack early - lost touch a furlong out and squeezed for space with the line approaching - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Held up in the pack early under pressure - pushed along with two furlongs to run - hit the front approaching the final furlong - edged off a true line but found more to score
Pulled hard early - went to front - pressed for effort 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left and drifted right - unable to reclaim advantage late
Settled towards the back early - angled right approaching 2f out and pushed along to close on the front group - stayed on at one gauge inside the final furlong - finished third beaten 3 lengths
Held up in leading group early - pressed for effort with over 2f left and gave way - dropped back through finish - eventually well beaten in 4th

Settled in third early - moved up to second approaching halfway and opened a break from the rest inside the final 3f - pressed the pace 2f out before hitting the front with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to score

Settled off the pace early - third and steady after halfway - made ground into contention 2f out but couldn't get on terms with a furlong to go - stayed on to snatch second in the last 50 yards - beaten a half-length
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage inside the final furlong when pushed along - stayed on to finish third
Sat close to the pack early - dropped to 6th after halfway - up to 4th with 4f left - unable to close from 2f out and held on for 4th
Slow to break and dropped well back - midpack in 6th around 4f out - unable to close from there and finished 5th
Sat just behind pace in 2nd early - slipped to 4th after halfway and 5th with 4f left - unable to threaten from 2f out and held to finish 6th
Settled just off the front pack - still in touch in 5th after halfway - dropped away 4f out - well beaten from there to finish last of note
Sent forward wide early - drifted right to hit the front before the first furlong was done - dictated with a firm gallop - kicked away entering the final furlong - won comfortably

Held up towards the back early - stuck for room approaching 2f out - made progress up the far flank inside the final two - moved into second inside the last furlong - kept responding under pressure to the line
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with a furlong left - closed on the front-runners inside the final furlong - kept on well but couldn't get up for second
Settled in the pack - pushed along to close on the front group inside final furlong - stayed on without further improvement close home to finish fourth

Went ahead briefly at the off - overtaken before the first furlong was done - sat close up - pressed the eventual winner from beyond halfway - drifted leftward with a furlong left - slipped from second inside the closing furlong - faded to finish fifth
Settled close to the pace early - lost momentum with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Held up in a forward spot early - driven approaching final furlong - lost ground close home - finished seventh
Held up towards the back - shifted through gears late inside closing furlong - finished off the effort - eventually eighth beaten 10 lengths
Knocked at the start - settled at the back - niggled into contention 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish ninth
Held up towards the back - shifted through the field 3f out - lost touch approaching final furlong and dropped away tamely to finish 10th
Drifted right and clipped opponent at the break - hesitant departure and towards the back - urged forward with just over a furlong left - faded soon after and beaten well by the finish

Went straight to front and dictated a even gallop - asked for effort entering the straight - clear by a couple of lengths inside the last furlong and looked unfurnished - kept finding more close home to win

Settled just off the front group early while fighting for control - 6th at halfway - moved into 4th turning for home - into 3rd with 2f left - upsides in 2nd a furlong out but unable to reel in the winner - stayed on at one gear to finish 2nd

Held up at the back - made progress from 3f out to lie 5th entering straight - improved into 2nd inside the final 2f - dropped to 3rd and held head aloft approaching the last furlong - unable to threaten and finished 3rd staying on same speed

Sat close to pace early and fought for control - clipped another runner after 4f then moved into second - asked for effort turning into straight - fourth approaching final 2f - unable to find more late
Sat close to the front early and clipped another runner after 4f before settling 3rd - asked for effort entering the straight - slipped to 5th 2f out - held no more in reserve late finishing 5th
Restrained in rear - 5th at halfway then dropped to 7th turning in - never able to land a blow
Held up towards the back - still down in 7th at halfway then pushed along in 6th turning for home - unable to close and finished well held
Settled just behind the pace with plenty of enthusiasm early - 4th at halfway - lost ground into the straight under pressure - faded from there to finish well beaten
Travelled strongly early - went in front from the middle - lost pole after a furlong - made steady progress to challenge two out - asked for effort and hit the front - stayed on strongly to the line
Settled off the pace through the field - pushed along with 2f left - found extra to close on leader inside final furlong - unable to get closer and beaten into 2nd

Drifted right early and grabbed the bit - travelled up with the pack through the middle - hit the front after a furlong - driven when challenged for the advantage 2f out - quickly overtaken - stayed on at one tempo - edged out of second close home to finish third
Fought for control early - travelled among midfield down the middle - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on late to finish 4th beaten 3 lengths
Started out on the far flank - hit the front early - pushed along and overtaken with 2f left - edged off a true line soon after - stayed on late without threatening the winner
Up with the leaders on the rail - pushed along 2f out and held one speed into the final furlong - sixth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back through the middle - pushed along with 2f left - denied a clean run inside the final furlong - stayed on without threatening - finished seventh
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack down the middle - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one gear inside final furlong to finish 8th
Towards the far rail - settled at the back of the field - nudged along 2f out and never able to land a blow
Held a handy spot down the middle - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away quickly - finished well held in 10th
Fought for control early - settled mid-division through the race - pressed for effort 2f out - lost ground quickly and finished well held
Pulling hard early - settled mid-division through the race - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch inside the final furlong
Pulled hard early travelling wide - stayed in range of the pace - pressed for effort 2f out - faded from there
Pulled hard early - settled at the back in the middle of the track - nudged along for a momentary advance past the 2f marker before fading sharply to finish 14th
Settled in the pack early - around 7th at halfway - into 6th when pushed along 2f out - up to 3rd close home - stayed on well to snatch it on the line
Set the pace early - opened a two length advantage with pushing needed a furlong out and battled on well - caught right at the line to finish second by a whisker
Sat close to the front pair early - back in 8th at halfway - made headway 3f out - moved up to second 2f out - couldn't get on terms in the final furlong but stayed on for third at the line
Settled in the pack early - moved up to 6th by halfway - made ground 4f out to lead 3rd spot 3f out - chased leaders 2f out but unable to threaten - held on for 4th
Sat handy in 4th early - moved up to 2nd 4f out - pressed for effort 3f out - dropped to 3rd 2f out and held for fifth
Sat second early behind pacesetter - slipped back to 5th before halfway then briefly worked up to 4th 3f out - dropped to 5th and found nothing approaching 2f out

Held up at the back - still down in 11th at halfway - found a bit of headway approaching the 3f marker - up to 8th with 2f left but hampered for room and drifted right with the rider losing balance inside the final two furlongs - unable to threaten late and finished well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - into 10th at halfway then 7th when driven with 2f left - unable to threaten leaders and well held in 8th
Held up towards the back - still 9th at halfway - unable to improve into the straight - finished well held
Settled just off the pace - third after 5f - fourth with 4f left - dropped away 3f out - faded soon after finishing well held
Handy in 3rd early - moved up to 2nd before halfway - dropped back to 3rd with 4f left - slipped further back approaching 3f out - faded from there to finish well beaten in 11th
Settled midpack early - lost touch and fell to rear by halfway - well beaten to the finish
Held up at back - shifted across two furlongs out - closed on front pair inside the last - stayed on well and hit the front close home - drew clear to score
Dwelt at the start - settled at back of field - urged forward approaching 2f out - stayed on strongly inside final furlong - moved into second close home - unable to find more late
Settled in second early - still upsides the front-runner inside the last furlong and pushed along - stayed on well to finish third
Set the pace early - came under pressure with 3f left and again inside final 2f - driven out a furlong from home - overtaken in the last furlong - dropped away close home to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - driven towards the middle ground with progress from over 2f out but lost momentum inside the last two furlongs and dropped away close home - finished fifth
Settled in the pack - slipped backwards 4f out - responded to close a little ground late but only stayed on at one gait to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - made ground on the front group past halfway - urged forward 3f out - dropped away rapidly in the final furlong to finish well beaten
Sat just behind pace - 7th at halfway - moved into 4th 3 out - cruised into 2nd approaching 2 out - driven to front last and stayed on to win
Settled midfield early - closed on pace before 3 out - up to 4th turning in - moved into 3rd shortly after - pushed along and stayed on to take 2nd on the run-in

Went straight to front - lost advantage before 1st then back in command by 5th - fumbled the following fence - asked for effort approaching 2 out - lost place at last - unable to find more and eased back to third on the run-in
Held up towards the back - improved into midfield after 3 out - urged into 5th turning for home - seriously hampered when left in 4th 2 out then only plodded on from the last
Held up towards the back - improved into midfield after 3 out - urged forward into 6th turning in and up to 5th 2 out - flattened out and stayed on steadily without troubling those ahead
Settled in the pack - given a nudge from three out and found little in 7th turning for home - up to 6th two out - stayed on same gait from the last to finish sixth
Held up at the back - driven up after 3 out to 8th before promoted to 7th when a rival departed 2 out - stayed on steadily from the last to finish 7th
Sat close to the front pair - second at the midpoint - driven approaching three out then found nothing and dropped away
Settled in the pack early - moved closer to the front after 3 out - asked for effort in the straight but faded before the following fence
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - well beaten in 10th
Sat close to the front pack - blundered 4 out - driven soon after and faded from the following fence - well held in 11th
Settled in the pack early - jumped awkwardly at the opening fence and again three out - came down at the fifth
Sat close to the pace early - moved up into second before 3 out - had nothing left in third when down at 2 out
Held up towards the back - given encouragement after the 4th - made no headway and pulled up before two out
Held up at the back of the pack - made no headway from halfway - eased out of contention before the second-last
Held up towards the back - made no impression on the leading group - eased and pulled up before the second-last
Sat just behind the front group - 5th at halfway - driven approaching 3 out then found nothing more - pulled up before the following fence
Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front before the 1st then lost that spot by the 5th - sat 4th at halfway - form gave way abruptly 5 out - eased and pulled up before 2 out
Drifted left at the off - settled handy - hit the front 3f out - driven approaching 2f out and edged two lengths in command entering the last furlong - kept on well to score
Knocked at the break - fought for control early - close enough to the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - moved into second inside final furlong but unable to trouble winner
Set the pace early - overtaken approaching 3f out and pushed along as ground was surrendered 2f out - rallied inside the final furlong - grabbed third close home
Drifted left at the off - settled in the pack - made progress over 2f out and pressed on - edged closer inside the final furlong - dropped to fourth close home
Fought for control early - settled in the pack then pressed for the lead 2f out - couldn't find more and faded close home
Handy early behind the front group - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at one gait inside final furlong - finished 6th
Settled off the pace in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch soon after and beaten into 7th
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - settled midpack early on - pushed along with 2f left before fading finished 8th
Held up rear from the off - never a factor - well beaten in 9th
Drifted left at the break and pulled hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along and lost ground from 2f out
Led throughout - held a length edge with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to the line - won
Sat close to the pace in 3rd - found extra pace 2f out to loom up second and press for the lead inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to finish second beaten three quarters of a length
Sat just off the front pack in 4th - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close 1f out - stayed on to grab 3rd close home
Sat close behind pace-setter early - pushed along two out and moved up to press the front - dropped to third with a furlong left - held on for fourth without finding more
Held up at the back - pushed along early with no response 2f out - allowed to finish in own time to be 5th
Handy early with the pace - moved into second a furlong out - hit the front inside final 110 yards and stayed on strongly to win
Handy early - settled second - hit front 2f out - put under pressure and lost advantage inside final furlong - stayed on gamely but couldn't reassert late
Held mid-pack early - short of space and asked for effort approaching 2f out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong to move into third - lost momentum near the line
Settled towards the back early - made progress on the outer approaching 2f out - pushed along inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Held mid-pack early - made ground on the pace two out - then found little inside the last and dropped away
Settled at the back early - asked for effort with 2f left and edged closer inside the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish 6th
Held a forward position early - asked for effort over 2f out and driven approaching the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish 7th
Sent to the front early - lost command before the 1f mark - dropped away under pressure with 2f left - faded quickly through the finish
Handy early - hit front after the first furlong - pushed along when overtaken 2f out then lost touch inside final furlong - dropped away well held

Settled at the back early - urged forward approaching the final 3f then given more encouragement 2f out - dropped away swiftly and fell behind - eventually taken out of contention and pulled up inside the final furlong

Held up towards the back - improved into the pack after 3 out - closed on the front group entering the straight - driven into 3rd 2 out - asked for effort to hit the front last and stayed on strongly to win

Held up towards the back - improved into the pack approaching 3 out - closed on the front group entering the straight - hit the front 2 out then lost that spot at the last - stayed on steadily to the line for second
Settled in midfield - 6th at halfway - urged forward to reach 4th before 2 out and up to 3rd at the last - driven and stayed on same rate to finish 3rd
Sat handy behind front group - moved through to top spot approaching 3 out - driven up but had nothing more in reserve and slipped back to 4th before last - stayed on at one speed to the line

Sat close to the front group early - urged forward to lead the chasing pack turning into the straight then dropped to 5th finding little before 2 out - stayed on at one gear from the final flight to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - awkward at the first - urged into the pack after 3 out and up to 6th approaching the last - had nothing more in reserve and stayed on same rate to finish sixth
Sat close to the front group early - clipped first fence - 5th at halfway - driven on turning in - unable to find more in 7th before 2 out - stayed on same effort to finish 7th
Held up towards back of pack - urged forward on inside approaching 3 out - unable to close from there - well held at finish
Held up towards back of pack - moved up onto leading group's heels after 3 out - driven approaching straight then found nothing and dropped away before the following fence
Sat close to the front pack early - urged forward after 3 out and edged into third turning in - soon under pressure with nothing more to give - lost touch before 2 out and beaten well home
Sent forward in front early - shaken up before being overtaken past three out - dropped away rapidly approaching the straight - well beaten in 11th
Sat close to pace early - up in 2nd at halfway - driven on approaching 3 out then found nothing and dropped away before the following fence
Settled towards the back of the pack - made no headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - urged forward after 3 out - unable to make headway - well held in 14th
Handy with front group early - 8th at halfway - asked for effort after 3 out on the rail then found nothing and dropped away
Settled just behind the front group - third at halfway - lost touch approaching 4 out - eased and withdrawn from contention before the second-last
Held up towards the back - made no impression on the leading group - eased and pulled up before the second-last
Held up towards the back - hampered by errors along the way - pulled up after the 5th
Settled just off the front pack - moved into second with a furlong left before hitting the front after bumping with a runner close home - stayed on strongly to score
Travelled keenly in front - pressed and driven along inside final 2f - drifted left then lost advantage after bumping opponent - drifted right soon after - kept on to finish second
Settled towards the back - moved smartly right and into contention approaching the final furlong - up to third and stayed on well for 3rd
Settled midpack early - eased left approaching final two furlongs and made progress - moved into fourth inside the last - stayed on to finish fourth
Handy in the early stages - pressed for effort but found little a furlong out - dropped away inside the final 150 yards to finish 5th
Tracked front group early - slipped back approaching 4f out - looked inexperienced and made no headway from 2f out - finished sixth
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on in the closing stages without threatening
Settled around midfield - nudged into contention approaching final furlong but not close enough - lost ground late to finish eighth
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with over 2f left - faded from a furlong out to finish well held
Settled towards the back of the pack - checked in progress inside final furlong - unable to threaten leaders - finished tenth
Sluggish start - stayed near the back throughout - well held in 11th
Settled midfield early - dropped away with over 2f left - trailed home from the final furlong - finished 12th
Held up close to the pace early - ridden with two furlongs left - lost rhythm and dropped away through the closing stages - well held in 13th
Shared front spot early - edged clear inside final two furlongs and held a slim margin when asked for effort - stayed on strongly to win
Sat in fourth early - pushed along into third with a furlong and a half left - unable to close inside the final furlong - stayed on to snatch second right at the line
Shared the front spot early - lost command inside final two furlongs - stayed on well to finish 3rd

Hesitant to find footing early - settled near back of field - made steady headway to 5th by halfway - up to 4th but unable to threaten leaders inside final furlong - finished fourth holding effort to the line
Tracked the front group early - 6th at halfway and unable to close over a furlong out - stayed on late to finish 5th
Settled just behind the front group in 3rd - dropped back with over a furlong and a half remaining - unable to threaten from there - finished 6th
Held up towards the back - 7th at halfway - unable to make headway from 1½f out - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - settled at rear - never a factor - finished eighth
Slow to settle towards the back - still 8th at halfway - unable to close 2f out - finished well held in 9th

Sluggish break but eager - surged into contention with the front group by the end of the first furlong - closed strongly through the middle third - hit the front inside the last furlong - stayed on strongly to prevail
Set the pace early - pushed along when overtaken inside the final furlong - kept on chasing the winner close home but couldn't find more - held for second
Settled towards the back early - improved through the middle of the field from 2f out - finished strongly in the last furlong - grabbed third close home - stayed on to the line
Held up at the back - driven into contention over 2f out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong and stayed on to finish 4th
Up with the pace and travelling freely - hit the front after 2f - urged on from 2f out before collared at the 1f marker - faded to finish fifth
Held mid-pack early - urged for effort with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside final furlong
Sat close up early and held second spot - dropped back 2f out - faded to finish seventh

Held up towards back of the pack - still 11th at halfway - closed on the front group after 3 out - driven up into 2nd turning for home - shared the advantage briefly - asked for effort to hit the front close home and stayed on strongly

Held up towards back early - made headway into contention after 3 out - up to third before the last - shared the advantage at the final fence - pushed along and edged in front briefly then worn down late holding on for second

Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - closed on the front pair after 3 out - urged into 3rd turning into the straight - shared the lead 2 out - asked for effort into the last - eased back to 3rd close home and stuck on for the same result

Up with the front runner - disputed 2nd at halfway - hit the front 4 out - pressed on to open a gap after 3 out - collared and fell back to 4th approaching the following fence - one-paced from the last
Settled in the middle group early - urged forward into 4th after 3 out then held 5th nearing the final obstacle - unable to find more and stayed on same gait to finish
Held up at the back - urged into contention after three out and up to sixth before two out - stayed on without improving to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace early - 6th at halfway - moved into 3rd approaching 3 out and edged into second for a moment - then found nothing more and dropped away before the following fence
Sat handy behind pace - hit front 7th - lost advantage 4 out - driven into 2nd after 2 out then faded without response
Sat handy behind pace - 5th at halfway - driven approaching 3 out then faded
Held up in the pack - unable to close from 3 out - well held at the finish
Sat handy behind pace - third at halfway before fading 5 out under pressure - never threatening late and eased before 2 out
Went straight to front - jumped awkwardly 3rd then lost command 7th - dropped away rapidly approaching 4 out - never a threat and pulled up before 2 out
Settled towards the back of the pack - still 9th at the midpoint and unable to close in the closing stages - eased and pulled up approaching the following fence
Held up towards back of the field - still not going well when unseated rider 3 out
Settled behind the pace - held up for space with over 2f left - moved right and found clear ground with a furlong to go - stayed on strongly to get up in the final strides
Travelled close to the front - driven approaching 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong drifting right under pressure - caught in the closing strides to finish second by a short head
Dwelt at start - made progress into the pack 8f out - boxed in approaching 2f out - found room and improved inside final furlong - shifted right for a gap - kept on to take third
Held a midfield position - boxed for room approaching 2f out then edged right with slight contact - found extra a furlong from home - kept responding to the line - claimed fourth place close home
Hesitant start - soon back up front then gave way approaching final furlong - held on for fifth without finding more late
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left - late gain but always short of the front - finished sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
Tracked front group early - checked slightly 7f from home then knocked back after being clipped 2f out - unable to close from there finishing seventh
Settled towards the back - under pressure with two furlongs left - late headway near the line but never in the picture
Set the pace early - shaken up approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished 10th
Settled in the pack - fighting for a strong grip - shaken up wide with 2f left but couldn't find extra - dropped away in the closing furlong to finish 11th

Settled in the pack early - still down in 7th at the halfway point - improved into 5th around 2f out - made ground quickly a furlong from home - moved up to second and drew alongside inside the final 150 yards - hit the front close home and stayed on strongly to score
Settled midfield early - 11th at halfway - made ground 2f out - improved to 7th inside final furlong - stayed on to snatch second right on the line

Went straight to front - stretched advantage to three lengths by halfway - held two-length edge into final furlong despite being asked for effort - overtaken close home - finished third holding form to the line
Handy early - moved into second before halfway - pushed along from 2f out but couldn't find extra gear inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed for 4th
Held up at the back - closed in with two furlongs left - eighth and driven with a furlong to run - stayed on without threatening the front
Sat close behind the pace in 5th - pushed along into 4th 2f out - unable to close from over 1f out - finished 6th
Held up at the back - crept into it with 2f left - stayed on late without threatening to reach the front
Slow to find stride - held up towards the tail - stayed on in closing stages without threatening - finished 8th
Sat just off the front pack in 4th - moved up to 3rd with three furlongs left before pushing on briefly - dropped to 5th and held no more inside the final furlong
Settled in the pack early - 8th at halfway before making late gains 2f out - 6th and unable to go on inside final furlong
Sat close to the front group in 6th - pushed along with 2f left - unable to gain thereafter - eventually well held in 11th
Sluggish break - settled at back of field - made no impression thereafter
Settled around midfield early - down in 11th at halfway - unable to close from over 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - 9th at halfway - unable to close over 2f out - well held at the finish
Handy early in 3rd just off the front group before halfway - pushed along and down to 4th 3f out - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Tracked the front group early - urged into the lead approaching 2f out - showed inexperience with a furlong to run - quickened away close home to win with something in hand

Handy in the leading group early - pressed for effort with 2f left and drifted right soon after - responded and finished strongly through the last furlong - held no prospect of catching the dominant winner but took second
Settled in the pack - shaken up and progress made from 2f out - showed inexperience over 1f out - kept on strongly inside the final furlong to grab third
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - held effort inside final furlong to finish fourth
Set the pace early - urged on approaching 3f out then drifted left on the home turn and dropped back - overtaken with 2f left - unable to close again thereafter
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along and made progress 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong and finished held
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with over 2f left but couldn't quicken - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Dwelt and lurched left at the start - settled towards the back - closed on the field passing the 2f marker - pushed along over 1f out - no extra and finished eighth
Shared front spot early - dropped to second by halfway - back in command after 4 out - matched up entering straight - eased clear approaching 2 out then stayed on strongly to the line

Front early and holding a clear edge from the 4th - lost command 4 out then rallied to share the front turning in - asked for effort in 4th and made no dent before promoted to a distant 2nd after 2 out - stayed on at one speed from the last
Held up towards the back - improved into the pack after 3 out - hampered nearing the second-last and left in 4th - moved into 3rd after the last and stayed on to finish third

Sat close to the front pack early - 5th at the halfway point - urged forward approaching 3 out - found nothing when moved up to 4th and knocked about after the following fence - moved into 3rd for a moment before the last then faded to finish 4th
Sat close to the front group early - urged into 7th after three out then up to 5th passing the following fence - stayed on at one gear through the last to finish 5th
Held a midfield spot early - asked for effort in 10th after 3 out - improved into 8th by 2 out - stayed on late to finish 6th
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - driven on approaching 3 out then had little more to offer late
Sat close to pace early - settled midpack by halfway - unable to close from 3 out - eventually well held in 8th
Settled towards the back of the pack - unable to close from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - no real threat at any stage - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
